timeline.queue.title: Queued ({{count}})
timeline.queue.hint: Sent as one message when AI finishes
timeline.queue.sendHint: Queue message, sent automatically when AI finishes
timeline.queue.sendNowHint: Interrupt the current reply and send this now
timeline.queue.interruptedSent: Interrupted the current reply and sent
timeline.channel.focusComposer.label: Focus composer
timeline.channel.focusComposer.desc: Move the cursor into the session composer so you can start typing.
timeline.channel.scrollTo.label: Scroll timeline
timeline.channel.scrollTo.desc: payload: { position: "top" | "bottom" } scrolls to the top/bottom, or { messageId } jumps to a message.
timeline.channel.rewindRequested.label: Open rewind
timeline.channel.rewindRequested.desc: payload: { message, text } resends from the given message as the rewind point. Needs a message object, so it is normally not bound to a shortcut.
timeline.channel.composerAttachments.des: payload is an attachment list; replaces the composer's attachments.
timeline.channel.cycleModel.label: Cycle model
timeline.channel.cycleModel.desc: payload: { direction?: 1 | -1 } cycles through the model list (next by default).
timeline.channel.cycleThinking.label: Cycle thinking level
timeline.channel.cycleThinking.desc: payload: { direction?: 1 | -1 } cycles through the thinking levels (next by default).
